name: server
label: Riosoma address
help: Enter the HTTPS address you open Riosoma at, without a path.

name: token
label: Personal access token
help: In Riosoma, open Settings, then Personal access tokens.  Create a token with Read tables, fields, and views and Read records.  To write records, also allow Add, change, and delete records.  Instant triggers also need Change tables, fields, and views and the Creator or Owner role.
